info.title: LensDataPlaneService
info.description: Read-only session and turn API for an Iris Lens instance.

get.description: Lists every agent with at least one retained session, sorted by agent ID. The list spans all retained sessions regardless of range, so a selector can offer any agent the instance can show sessions for. An instance with no sessions returns an empty list.

Lists sessions for one agent in newest-activity-first order. Pagination fixes the first page's last-seen upper bound but does not materialize an immutable snapshot: concurrent activity can move sessions out of the remaining result set or change their relative order. Start a new traversal to obtain the current view. A cursor is valid only with the same effective filters used to create it; a mismatch returns BadRequestError.

parameters.description: Agent scope. Lens never exposes an unscoped session list.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Requested lookback range. The service clamps it to instance retention and returns effectiveRange.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque continuation returned by ListSessions. Its encoded payload contains snapshotUpperBound, lastSeen, sessionId, and a deterministic validation hash of the effective filters. Reusing it with different effective filters returns BadRequestError.

schema.description: Opaque continuation returned by ListSessions. Its encoded payload contains snapshotUpperBound, lastSeen, sessionId, and a deterministic validation hash of the effective filters. Reusing it with different effective filters returns BadRequestError.

get.description: Returns the retained turns and outcome facets for a session.
Returns one turn. turnId is the turn's OTel trace ID; Lens defines no separate turn identifier.

Returns captured content for one turn hash. Before reading the content tier, the service MUST load the addressed turn, verify that the turn references the requested hash, and enforce the turn's logical content expiry. A missing reference or expired logical reference returns a successful expired response with no body, so callers cannot distinguish expiration from a hash that was never stored.
Classifies only the captured result owned by the addressed Context Retriever span. Authorization, span ownership, and content expiry are enforced before loading the body.

Agent.description: One agent an instance has seen, identified by its raw iris.agent.id. A display label is not part of this contract yet; see the TDD's agents-seen record for the planned telemetry-sourced label.

capture.description: Why the text was not captured: the row's capture reason, else the span's capture state.

AgentMemoryOperation.description: Id and hash lists are capped and keep empty-string entries for index alignment; counts are the true totals.

sessionId.description: The session the server acknowledged, else the one requested.

eventId.description: The event the server acknowledged, else the one requested.

storeId.description: The memory store the call read, from iris.component.resource.id.

candidates.description: In the order the source returned them, which is its rank.

errorType.description: Safe exception class captured only for a failed call; never an exception message.

FieldError.description: Validation error details for a single request field.

field.description: Name of the invalid request field.

GatewayToolSpan.description: Context Gateway metadata recorded by the Lens SDK. Upstream server labels and component are self-reported, not verified identity. Captured bodies and raw handle IDs are never projected.

upstreamId.description: Nonempty UTF-8 telemetry text, bounded by assembly max_text_bytes and omitted by the read API when it exceeds 512 bytes. Never contains a raw Gateway handle ID.

originalToolName.description: Nonempty UTF-8 telemetry text, bounded by assembly max_text_bytes and omitted by the read API when it exceeds 512 bytes. Never contains a raw Gateway handle ID.

catalogRevision.description: Nonempty UTF-8 telemetry text, bounded by assembly max_text_bytes and omitted by the read API when it exceeds 512 bytes. Never contains a raw Gateway handle ID.

upstreamServerName.description: Nonempty UTF-8 telemetry text, bounded by assembly max_text_bytes and omitted by the read API when it exceeds 512 bytes. Never contains a raw Gateway handle ID.

upstreamServerVersion.description: Nonempty UTF-8 telemetry text, bounded by assembly max_text_bytes and omitted by the read API when it exceeds 512 bytes. Never contains a raw Gateway handle ID.

upstreamComponent.description: Known Iris component reported by the Upstream: agent_memory, playbook, context_retriever, or context_gateway.

upstreamDurationMs.description: Nonnegative recorded integer in the exact JavaScript integer range.

resultCacheStatus.description: hit when the Gateway reports a result cache hit. Absence does not imply a miss.

resultCacheAgeMs.description: Age of the cached result, present only with resultCacheStatus hit.

failureReason.description: The Gateway failure reason, an open vocabulary. This does not replace the SDK-recorded tool outcome.

failureStage.description: Observed failure stage: connect, redirect, call, input_required, or result.

failureCompletion.description: Observed completion certainty: not_dispatched or unknown.

failureUpstreamCode.description: Recorded signed integer in the exact JavaScript integer range.

resultHandleRef.description: Non-capability correlation reference, never a raw handle ID.

resultHandleShape.description: Recorded result shape: collection, document, or text.

resultHandleCompleteness.description: Recorded result completeness: complete, partial, or unknown.

resultHandleBytes.description: Nonnegative recorded integer in the exact JavaScript integer range.

resultHandleItems.description: Nonnegative recorded integer in the exact JavaScript integer range.

searchResultCount.description: Number of tools returned by search_tools, including an observed zero.

body.description: Present only when availability is available.

spans.description: Root nodes for the turn trace.

contextRetrieverToolSteps.description: Read-time grouping of Context Retriever calls under the nearest foreign execute_tool span. The original spans remain in spans.

resourceReads.description: Component resource reads in turn order; resource bytes are not captured.

playbookOperations.description: Observed Playbook proposal and publication operations in turn order, including proposal reads; content bodies are not captured.

componentOperations.description: Observed component calls that are not retrievals, such as Agent Memory writes and text-less searches, in turn order. operation is verbatim; content bodies are not captured.

hasUserIds.description: Whether any retained session for this instance has observed a user ID. This instance-level retained-index capability is independent of agent, range, filters, page, and cursor.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted when this is the final page.

effectiveRange.description: The requested range after retention clamping.

items.description: Positive lookback duration such as 24h, 7d, or 30d.

availableRanges.description: Ranges available for this instance, intersected across index and metrics retention.

ToolOutcome.description: ok means the call returned and does not assert tool success, including an MCP isError result without a Gateway failure entry. A Gateway failure entry can make it failed. Lens keeps the producer's outcome, including invalid_arguments recorded as ok.

name.description: Nonempty UTF-8 protocol tool name, preserved verbatim by Lens.

title.description: The MCP tool title from tools/list when the SDK recorded it; Lens does not synthesize a title.
